file.description: Path as it appears in the diff (new side)

line.description: Last line of the range, new side, inside the changed-lines map

startLine.description: First line for multi-line ranges; omit for one line

category.description: e.g. sqli, xss, null-check, missing-test, acceptance-criteria, naming, a11y

fix.description: Replacement code; omit if no concrete fix

fixReplacesRange.description: True if fix replaces exactly startLine..line (enables GitHub suggestion)

rereview.description: Only for previous Tyr comments in this lens

outsideDiff.description: ALTA risks triggered by the change in unchanged code; summary only
